name: @morocco-pc/recommendation-runtime
description: Database-backed recommendation execution: loaders, persistence and orchestration over an injected client. Step 5 W0 shipped the package harness (boundary, surface and transaction-ownership tests); W1 has since moved ten modules - the Engine 2 offer pre-selection query and its public barrel, the two query loaders and their barrel, the two scoring loaders, the candidate and filtering-context loaders, and the filtering composition filterCandidatesForRecommendation (src/{offers,query,scoring,candidates,filtering}/, each behind an identity shim at its old path) - and the public surface is still empty until W1 completes its loaders namespace.
